summary: Iteration 22 - Testing NEW streak system on Le Cercle page. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - streak card display, check-in flow, reward popup, milestone timeline, navbar credit update verified. The streak system is fully functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/streak/status - requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/streak/status - returns initial state for new user (streak_count=0, checked_in_today=false, next_milestone.days=7)
Backend: POST /api/streak/checkin - requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: POST /api/streak/checkin - first checkin gives streak_count=1, credits_earned=1, already_checked_in=false
Backend: POST /api/streak/checkin - second same-day checkin gives already_checked_in=true, credits_earned=0
Backend: GET /api/streak/status - after checkin shows streak_count=1, checked_in_today=true, total_checkins=1
Backend: POST /api/streak/checkin - credits_earned=1 added to wallet (balance increases by 1)
Backend: GET /api/wallet/transactions - shows check-in transaction with description 'Check-in jour 1'
Backend: Milestone bonuses correctly defined (7:+3cr, 14:+5cr, 30:+10cr, 60:+15cr, 100:+25cr)
Frontend: /cercle when not authenticated shows 'Créer un compte' in streak card
Frontend: /cercle shows streak card with 'Commencez votre streak' when not checked in
Frontend: /cercle 'CHECK-IN DU JOUR' button visible and clickable
Frontend: Clicking check-in shows reward popup with flame icon
Frontend: Reward popup shows 'Jour 1', '+1 crédit', next milestone info ('Prochain palier dans 6 jours (+3 bonus)')
Frontend: Reward popup shows 'Continuer' button that closes popup
Frontend: After checkin, streak card shows '1 jour consécutif', green 'CHECK-IN FAIT' badge
Frontend: After checkin, progress bar updated (1/7 = ~14% filled)
Frontend: After checkin, navbar credit balance updated from 20 to 21 credits
Frontend: Milestone timeline shows 5 milestones (7, 14, 30, 60, 100) with bonus amounts (+3cr, +5cr, +10cr, +15cr, +25cr)
Frontend: After page reload, CHECK-IN button replaced with 'CHECK-IN FAIT' badge (prevents duplicate check-in)

test_credentials.note: Backend tests create unique users with uuid-based emails for each run

seed_data_creation: No seed data required - tests create unique users per run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 verified the NEW streak system. Backend endpoints: GET /api/streak/status (returns streak_count, checked_in_today, next_milestone), POST /api/streak/checkin (first checkin gives streak_count=1 + 1 credit, second same-day gives already_checked_in=true).
